context_requirements: Expression of PRKCA (PKCα) or related diacylglycerol/calcium-responsive PKC isoforms
Intact downstream MAPK/AP-1 and NF-κB signaling modules
Proliferative or stress-responsive transcriptional state for secondary cell-cycle effects
falsifiers: No consistent induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in any responsive line
No suppression of proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h
Responses that are equally strong in all nine lines regardless of PRKCA expression or lineage

evidence.supports: Modulation of MAPK/AP-1 signaling by a PKC-related activator in osteoclasts, supporting PKC activator effects on immediate-early and AP-1 target genes.
AMPK activator AICAR represses insulin/BETA2 gene expression, showing kinase activators can drive specific transcriptional programs.
AMPK activator treatment reduces Th2 cytokine expression in human CD4+ T cells, supporting kinase activator anti-inflammatory transcriptional effects.
PACT/PRKRA, a protein kinase activator, modulates DMRT1 transcriptional activity, supporting kinase activators as transcriptional regulators.
